Ankit Bawne Continues Cricket Career After 19 Seasons

Maharashtra batter Ankit Bawne, after 19 seasons, scored a century against Services following a season where he made 72 runs. He conveyed a message to his dugout stating, 'I am still playing, still performing, still alive' as he continues to pursue his dream of playing for India.
